text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory was checking the apology letters
submitted to the Disciplinary Committee all by herself, butâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...'Now I understand that you warned me so many times for my own good'..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right, sir! It's not like
the Disciplinary Committee is trying to harass anyone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What a moving letter of apology...!
I'm so glad I joined the Disciplinary Committee...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just a few minutes left until training.
However...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I just have to share these burning feelings! A reply! I must write one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bamboo Memory became so engrossed in writing
replies to the reflection letters that she ended up skipping training.
